standard.summary: 每次同步时慢权重向快权重移动的比例。
standard.effect: 默认 0.5（论文推荐）。必须落在 (0, 1] 区间，越界直接报错。
standard.whenToUse: 保持 0.5。想让慢权重更保守可以调小。
standard.avoidWhen: 设 0 或大于 1 会直接报错拒绝启动。

standard_en.summary: The fraction of the way the slow weights move toward the fast weights at each sync.
standard_en.effect: Default 0.5 (paper recommendation). Must be in (0, 1] or startup fails.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep 0.5. Lower values make the slow weights lazier.
standard_en.avoidWhen: 0 or above 1 fails closed with an error at startup.
